The target is an Apple M3 Pro (arm64, 6 performance + 6 efficiency cores), and `gcc` here is Apple clang without OpenMP. I wrote the matmul with NEON intrinsics and pthreads. It passes the correctness check at 25 sizes from 1 to 1025, and n=1000 runs in about 2.4 ms (~830 GFLOPS). The previous attempt took 10.3 ms.

What it does:
- **Kernel:** each step computes an 8×12 block of C, holding 24 NEON accumulators in registers.
- **Packing:** A is copied into 8-row interleaved blocks, and B is copied once into 12-column panels per K block, padded with zeros so any n works.
- **Block sizes:** KC=512, MC=96, NC=192, chosen by a parameter sweep.
- **Threads:** all 12 cores take tiles from a shared atomic queue, which balances work between the fast and slow cores. Very small matrices run single-threaded.

```c
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <arm_neon.h>

#define MR 8
#define NR 12
#define KC 512
#define MC 96
#define NC 192
#define MAXT 16

typedef struct {
    const float *A, *B;
    float *C, *Bp;
    int n, npan, kblocks;
    atomic_int pack_next, pack_done, task_next;
    int ntasks, nmb, nnb;
} ctx_t;

/* Bp layout: for each k-block kb, for each panel p: kc x NR floats */
static void pack_b_panel(ctx_t *c, int p) {
    int n = c->n, j0 = p * NR, w = n - j0 < NR ? n - j0 : NR;
    for (int kb = 0; kb < c->kblocks; kb++) {
        int k0 = kb * KC, kc = n - k0 < KC ? n - k0 : KC;
        float *dst = c->Bp + (size_t)k0 * c->npan * NR + (size_t)p * kc * NR;
        for (int k = 0; k < kc; k++) {
            const float *src = c->B + (size_t)(k0 + k) * n + j0;
            float *d = dst + k * NR;
            if (w == NR) memcpy(d, src, NR * sizeof(float));
            else {
                int j = 0;
                for (; j < w; j++) d[j] = src[j];
                for (; j < NR; j++) d[j] = 0.f;
            }
        }
    }
}

static void pack_a(const float *A, int n, int i0, int mc, int k0, int kc, float *Ap) {
    for (int ib = 0; ib < mc; ib += MR) {
        int h = mc - ib < MR ? mc - ib : MR;
        float *d = Ap + (size_t)ib * kc;
        if (h == MR) {
            const float *r[MR];
            for (int r0 = 0; r0 < MR; r0++) r[r0] = A + (size_t)(i0 + ib + r0) * n + k0;
            for (int k = 0; k < kc; k++)
                for (int r0 = 0; r0 < MR; r0++) d[k * MR + r0] = r[r0][k];
        } else {
            for (int k = 0; k < kc; k++)
                for (int r0 = 0; r0 < MR; r0++)
                    d[k * MR + r0] = r0 < h ? A[(size_t)(i0 + ib + r0) * n + k0 + k] : 0.f;
        }
    }
}

static inline void kernel(int kc, const float *a, const float *b, float *C, int ldc,
                          int h, int w, int accum) {
    float32x4_t c00 = vdupq_n_f32(0), c01 = c00, c02 = c00, c10 = c00, c11 = c00, c12 = c00,
                c20 = c00, c21 = c00, c22 = c00, c30 = c00, c31 = c00, c32 = c00,
                c40 = c00, c41 = c00, c42 = c00, c50 = c00, c51 = c00, c52 = c00,
                c60 = c00, c61 = c00, c62 = c00, c70 = c00, c71 = c00, c72 = c00;
    for (int k = 0; k < kc; k++) {
        float32x4_t b0 = vld1q_f32(b), b1 = vld1q_f32(b + 4), b2 = vld1q_f32(b + 8);
        float32x4_t a0 = vld1q_f32(a), a1 = vld1q_f32(a + 4);
        c00 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c00, b0, a0, 0); c01 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c01, b1, a0, 0); c02 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c02, b2, a0, 0);
        c10 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c10, b0, a0, 1); c11 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c11, b1, a0, 1); c12 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c12, b2, a0, 1);
        c20 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c20, b0, a0, 2); c21 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c21, b1, a0, 2); c22 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c22, b2, a0, 2);
        c30 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c30, b0, a0, 3); c31 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c31, b1, a0, 3); c32 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c32, b2, a0, 3);
        c40 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c40, b0, a1, 0); c41 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c41, b1, a1, 0); c42 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c42, b2, a1, 0);
        c50 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c50, b0, a1, 1); c51 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c51, b1, a1, 1); c52 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c52, b2, a1, 1);
        c60 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c60, b0, a1, 2); c61 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c61, b1, a1, 2); c62 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c62, b2, a1, 2);
        c70 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c70, b0, a1, 3); c71 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c71, b1, a1, 3); c72 = vfmaq_laneq_f32(c72, b2, a1, 3);
        a += MR; b += NR;
    }
    float tmp[MR * NR];
    float32x4_t acc[MR][3] = {{c00, c01, c02}, {c10, c11, c12}, {c20, c21, c22}, {c30, c31, c32},
                              {c40, c41, c42}, {c50, c51, c52}, {c60, c61, c62}, {c70, c71, c72}};
    if (h == MR && w == NR) {
        for (int r = 0; r < MR; r++) {
            float *cr = C + (size_t)r * ldc;
            for (int v = 0; v < 3; v++) {
                float32x4_t x = acc[r][v];
                if (accum) x = vaddq_f32(x, vld1q_f32(cr + 4 * v));
                vst1q_f32(cr + 4 * v, x);
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int r = 0; r < MR; r++)
            for (int v = 0; v < 3; v++) vst1q_f32(tmp + r * NR + 4 * v, acc[r][v]);
        for (int r = 0; r < h; r++)
            for (int j = 0; j < w; j++)
                C[(size_t)r * ldc + j] = accum ? C[(size_t)r * ldc + j] + tmp[r * NR + j] : tmp[r * NR + j];
    }
}

static void *worker(void *arg) {
    ctx_t *c = arg;
    int n = c->n;
    int p;
    while ((p = atomic_fetch_add(&c->pack_next, 1)) < c->npan) {
        pack_b_panel(c, p);
        atomic_fetch_add(&c->pack_done, 1);
    }
    while (atomic_load(&c->pack_done) < c->npan) ;

    float *Ap = aligned_alloc(64, sizeof(float) * MC * KC);
    int t;
    while ((t = atomic_fetch_add(&c->task_next, 1)) < c->ntasks) {
        int mb = t / c->nnb, nb = t % c->nnb;
        int i0 = mb * MC, mc = n - i0 < MC ? n - i0 : MC;
        int j0 = nb * NC, nc = n - j0 < NC ? n - j0 : NC;
        for (int kb = 0; kb < c->kblocks; kb++) {
            int k0 = kb * KC, kc = n - k0 < KC ? n - k0 : KC;
            pack_a(c->A, n, i0, mc, k0, kc, Ap);
            const float *Bk = c->Bp + (size_t)k0 * c->npan * NR;
            for (int jj = 0; jj < nc; jj += NR) {
                int jp = (j0 + jj) / NR, w = nc - jj < NR ? nc - jj : NR;
                const float *bp = Bk + (size_t)jp * kc * NR;
                for (int ii = 0; ii < mc; ii += MR) {
                    int h = mc - ii < MR ? mc - ii : MR;
                    kernel(kc, Ap + (size_t)ii * kc, bp, c->C + (size_t)(i0 + ii) * n + j0 + jj, n,
                           h, w, kb > 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    free(Ap);
    return NULL;
}

void matmul(const float *A, const float *B, float *C, int n) {
    ctx_t c;
    c.A = A; c.B = B; c.C = C; c.n = n;
    c.npan = (n + NR - 1) / NR;
    c.kblocks = (n + KC - 1) / KC;
    c.nmb = (n + MC - 1) / MC;
    c.nnb = (n + NC - 1) / NC;
    c.ntasks = c.nmb * c.nnb;
    size_t bsz = (size_t)n * c.npan * NR * sizeof(float);
    c.Bp = aligned_alloc(64, (bsz + 63) & ~(size_t)63);
    atomic_init(&c.pack_next, 0);
    atomic_init(&c.pack_done, 0);
    atomic_init(&c.task_next, 0);

    long nt = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
    if (nt < 1) nt = 1;
    if (nt > MAXT) nt = MAXT;
    long work = (long)n * n * n;
    if (work < 2000000L) nt = 1;
    else if (nt > c.ntasks) nt = c.ntasks;

    pthread_t th[MAXT];
    int started = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < nt; i++)
        if (pthread_create(&th[started], NULL, worker, &c) == 0) started++;
    worker(&c);
    for (int i = 0; i < started; i++) pthread_join(th[i], NULL);
    free(c.Bp);
}
```

FLAGS: -O3 -mcpu=native
